optimizedDescription.value: Central entity owning spec-work lifecycle, approvals, artifacts, invalidation, implementation tracking, and append-only history.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules

- Identity: immutable unique slug `name`; immutable `createdAt`; mandatory event `ActorIdentity` with `name`, `email`, optional `provider`, `providerId`, `metadata: Record<string, string>`.
- Revision: persist `updatedAt`; default `createdAt`; never before `createdAt`; `touchUpdatedAt(at: Date = new Date())` sets/advances.
- Scope: mutable, possibly empty `specIds`; validate workspace components at creation. Modification invalidates approvals. `workspaces` runtime-derived via `parseSpecId()`, never persisted/primary. `specDependsOn` optional per-spec map, highest-priority `CompileContext` source; updates do not invalidate; `updateSpecIds()` prunes removed keys. Remaining dependencies resolve dynamically/transitively from metadata.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`; optional `approvals.spec` routes through `pending-spec-approval → spec-approved`; optional `approvals.signoff` routes through `pending-signoff → signed-off`. Gates default false. `VALID_TRANSITIONS` authoritative; every non-drafting state may return designing; `designing → designing` does not invalidate/downgrade.
- From `archiving`, only `archivable` and `designing`; others throw `InvalidStateTransitionError`. Pre-commit failure stays archivable. Commit failure attempts batch restore: success returns archivable; restore failure stays archiving. Post-move metadata/hook failure does not undo archive.
- `implementing → verifying` requires task completion through workflow `taskCompletionCheck`. `implementation-failure` returns verifying to implementing without invalidation; reset only `implementing.requires`. `artifact-review-required` returns designing. Artifact drift independently invalidates.
- Implementation facts separate from artifacts: `trackedImplementationFiles` project-relative with `open|resolved|ignored|removed`; removed persists and reopens only after refresh proves existence. `implementationLinks` supports file and symbol refinements; active paths remain project-relative until archive normalization. Preserve explicit file-level link versus container-only set when final symbol removed.
- Explicit tracking activation persists `implementationTrackingStartedAt: Date | null`; `isImplementationTrackingActive` iff non-null; `startImplementationTracking(at?: Date)` records once and preserves initial timestamp on repeated calls.
- Historical implementation signal scans history for any `transitioned.to === implementing`; once true remains true, gates detection and draft/discard safeguards. Entity performs no detection.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` has `type`, `optional`, ordered `requires`, persisted aggregate `state`, `files: Map<string, ArtifactFile>`. File has `key`, `filename`, explicit persisted `state`, `validatedHash`, `hasDrift`. Hash uses schema `preHashCleanup`; `"__skipped__"` marks explicit optional skip.
- States: `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`; explicit state plus presence authoritative, never hash alone. Aggregate priority: drifted; pending; all complete/skipped => complete; all skipped => skipped; all missing/no files => missing; else in-progress. `pending-parent-artifact-review` represents recursive upstream review blocking.
- Only optional artifacts may skip; complete/skipped satisfy `requires`. `ChangeArtifact.markComplete(key, hash)` only `ValidateArtifacts`; `markSkipped()` only skip use case. Return/designing or scope change reopens per policy; drifted meaning persists.
- `syncArtifacts(artifactTypes)` reconciles schema types/files, returns changed flag, and appends `artifacts-synced` with `SYSTEM_ACTOR`.
- History append-only; lifecycle from latest transition, draft status from latest drafted/restored, active approval latest approval without later invalidation. Every event has `type`, ISO `at`, mandatory `by`. Events include created, transitioned, approvals, invalidated, drafted/restored, artifact-skipped, artifacts-synced, description-updated, discarded, archive-failed.
- `invalidated` carries `spec-change|artifact-drift|artifact-review-required|spec-overlap-conflict`, human message, deduplicated artifact/file targets. Overlap names archived change/specs and rolls back designing. `archive-failed` records `prepare|commit|archive`, message, `commitStarted`.
- `created` records schema name/version. Name mismatch throws `SchemaMismatchError`; same-name version mismatch warns but remains usable/archivable.
- Draft moves active to drafts; restore only `RestoreChange` via `mutateDraft`; discard irreversible with reason/actor and optional superseders. Historical implementing requires force. Drafted changes read-only except restore/discard; inspect as `DraftedChangeView`.
- `Change.invalidate()` requires cause, message, focused targets, `artifactDag: ArtifactDag`; optional override supersedes persisted policy. Always appends invalidation and returns designing when needed. Policies: none, surgical, downstream via `artifactDag.descendantsOf()`, global. Never infer DAG through persisted `requires` or private BFS.
- `hasDrift` persists per file; only artifact-drift sets focused targets. Manual review invalidation neither sets nor clears. Missing remains canonical missing; complete+drift may render complete-with-drift.
- `LifecycleEngine`, not `Change`, interprets schema DAG, recursive blockers, approval routing, step reachability, effective artifact status. Entity owns persisted facts.

## Constraints

- `name`/`createdAt` immutable; `updatedAt >= createdAt`.
- `workspaces` plural derived/non-persisted; empty `specIds` valid; no primary workspace.
- History immutable and lifecycle-authoritative; no state snapshot.
- Artifact state explicit; `validatedHash` baseline only; `hasDrift` independent.
- Reopening policy-driven; skipped optional-only and dependency-satisfying.
- Archive only from archivable; both approval gates opt-in.
- Verifying to implementing never invalidates approvals.
- Draft/discard after implementation require force; discard irreversible with reason/actor.
- Effective blocker/workflow interpretation belongs only to `LifecycleEngine`.
